name: std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator<T>::new_object

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
ctor_args

 -

 the arguments to forward to the constructor of U

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: A pointer to the allocated and constructed object.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text:
This function was introduced for use with the fully-specialized allocator std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator<>, but it may be useful in any specialization as a shortcut to avoid having to rebind from std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator<T> to std::pmr::polymorphic_allocator<U>, and having to call allocate, construct, and deallocate individually.

Since U is not deduced, it must be provided as a template argument when calling this function.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: May throw any exceptions thrown by the call to allocate_object or the constructor of U.

examples.title: Practical use case
examples.input: Allocate, construct, destroy, and release storage. Public allocate/deallocate/is_equal dispatch to each resource's protected do_* implementation.

summary: Allocates and constructs an object of type U.
